text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as sorting data and answering simple customer questions. This allows employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Productivity tools powered by AI, like smart calendars and writing assistants, help people save time and make fewer mistakes. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, as workers and machines solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, so workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers many benefits, but it also requires people to adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
